profile.name: Burak Şahin
profile.summary: ICU nurse with 3 years of experience in an adult intensive care unit.

descriptions: Provided nursing care to ventilated patients in the adult intensive care unit
Monitored patients on mechanical ventilation together with the respiratory therapist
Administered medications according to physician orders
Recorded vital signs and care notes in the hospital information system
Responsible for patient and family education before discharge
Worked in a team of 12 nurses on rotating shifts
